answer: Reciprocity ban: if wallet A attested B within the last 6 epochs, B's attestation of A carries zero weight, so mutual pairs earn nothing. Pearl is the pair ledger, a table of directed attestations keyed by sender and receiver. Summit is the ceiling per pair: 1 weighted attestation per 6 epochs. Willow is the fallback for rings: any cycle of length 3 or 4 in the ledger counts as 1 attestation in total. Failure mode: three wallets attesting in a triangle. Check rule: a graph scan flags every cycle up to length 4. Cheapest bypass: cycles of length 5 unless one funding tree links them.
